# lerpWrap

## Summary

Smoothstep-interpolates a 10-entry per-hue table (like `C_PEAK` or `V_PEAK`) at a fractional hue position `h` in `[0, 1)`, wrapping around the hue circle so `5RP` blends back into `5R`.

## Import

```javascript
import { lerpWrap, C_PEAK } from '../utils/munsell';
```

## Usage

```javascript
let peakChroma = lerpWrap(C_PEAK, 0.35); // peak chroma between 5GY and 5G
```
